title: Service page content (canonical v2)
description: Contract for wordpress/themes/<theme>/content/services/<slug>.json. Canonical per ADR-0003. Rendered by template-parts/written-page.php, the same renderer location pages use — a service file with sections publishes them; one without falls back to the config-driven layout. See docs/architecture/content-schema.md.

slug.description: Must match the filename and a services.cards item slug in business-config.php.

seo_title.description: Read directly by lvjcb_compute_seo(). SEO_STANDARDS.md §3 caps this at 60 characters after {business} resolves.

seo_description.description: Read directly by lvjcb_compute_seo(), then truncated at 155 characters by lvjcb_truncate_for_seo().
